olympus: A white marble temple with a golden roof stands on the flat summit of a great grey rock mountain, flanked by two golden orbs on pedestals. Only the ground right round the temple is snow; the mountain below is grey rock in stepped ledges.
delphi: A marble temple and a round marble shrine, both with terracotta roofs, and a carved white stone egg on a plinth.
delos: A small marble temple with a terracotta roof and a palm tree.
lemnos: A stone forge with a chimney and a dark doorway; a bearded smith stands by an anvil.
dodona: One huge oak tree with a thick trunk and a broad green crown, bronze cauldrons on tripods around it, and a priest in white. No house.
sounion: A marble temple with a terracotta roof on a stone platform at the cape.
ida: A jagged grey rock outcrop with pointed crags and a natural cave mouth in bare grey rock (a cave, not a building); a bronze-armoured warrior with a round shield and a white goat stand outside.
etna: A broad volcano of dark grey lava rock, with ridges and gullies down its slopes and an open crater at the top glowing red inside.
othrys: Ruined dark stone towers of a fortress.
ephesus: A large marble temple with a terracotta roof; a golden statue on a pedestal and a deer beside it.
enna: A meadow scattered with red, yellow, purple, white and pink flowers around a dark pit; a girl in a yellow dress picks flowers.
naxos: A great marble doorway standing alone with no roof: two pillars and a lintel. Rows of grapevines beside it, and two figures: a man in purple with a staff and a woman in pink.
tainaron: A dark jagged rock outcrop with a natural cave mouth in bare grey rock (a cave, not a building); a black three-headed dog stands guard in front. No houses.
hesperides: A great tree hung with golden apples, a green serpent coiled round its trunk, and three maidens around it.
arcadia: A goat-legged god plays pipes on a rock among white sheep and a goat.
pactolus: Five trees whose leaves are solid gold (trees, not huts), a king in purple with a golden crown raising his hands, and a stream with gold nuggets.
athens: The Parthenon, a marble temple with an open colonnade all round and a terracotta roof, on a pale limestone crag. One tall golden statue of a goddess with a round shield stands at the left end of the temple, and nowhere else. Small white houses with terracotta roofs at the foot.
mycenae: An ancient Bronze Age citadel ringed by massive pale walls of huge stone blocks, with a gate topped by a triangular relief; a palace with red columns inside.
sparta: A temple with a bronze-coloured roof, houses with red roofs, and a large round bronze shield bearing a red lambda.
corinth: A long bare ramp of rock rising to the right, a small spring pool and two houses.
thebes: An ancient city ringed by pale stone walls with plain square towers and a dark gate, houses with terracotta roofs inside. Outside, a sphinx with a lion's body, a woman's head and white wings sits on a rock.
olympia: A marble temple with a terracotta roof, a bronze cauldron, and a sandy running track between grass banks.
lerna: A murky green swamp with reeds and a mound in the middle.
stymphalia: A pale blue lake with reeds.
pylos: A palace hall with red columns, storage jars in a row, and an old king in blue with white hair.
iolcos: A harbour: a wooden shipyard frame on a stone quay, and houses with terracotta roofs.
pelion: A grey rock outcrop with pointed crags and a natural cave mouth in bare grey rock (a cave, not a building); a centaur stands outside, the upper body of a bearded man joined to the body of a brown horse, with a boy in white holding a lyre.
troy: An ancient Bronze Age city ringed by high sloping sand-coloured walls with plain square towers, houses inside, and outside the gate a huge wooden horse on wheels.
rhodes: A colossal bronze statue of a man with a spiked golden crown raising a torch, standing on a white pedestal, with small houses at its feet.
knossos: A palace with a row of red columns and a blue frieze, behind a large square stone maze seen from above.
lycia: A pointed grey rock; beside it one monster, the chimera: a golden lion with a grey goat's head rising from its back and a green snake for a tail. No house.
gorgons: A sandy rock outcrop with a pointed crag and a natural cave mouth in bare grey rock (a cave, not a building); a green woman with snakes for hair stands in the mouth, and grey stone statues of warriors stand around.
thrace: A musician in white with a golden lyre sits on a rock; a deer, a wolf and a white bird listen, with two trees nearby. No building.
chios: An old blind poet with a white beard sits on a rock holding a lyre, beside a small olive tree. No house.
ismarus: A small ancient town ringed by a plain stone wall, houses with terracotta roofs inside, wine jars in a row outside.
lotus: Giant pink lotus flowers with yellow centres on green stalks, palm trees, and two sailors lying asleep on the sand. No house.
cyclops: A big outcrop of grey rock with pointed crags and a natural cave mouth in bare grey rock (a cave, not a building); white sheep in a stone pen beside it.
laestrygonia: Two enormous bearded giants, living men in brown tunics (not statues, not towers), each standing on a rock stack and lifting a grey boulder over his head; a wrecked wooden boat below.
aeaea: A stone house with a purple roof and a chimney, cypress trees, and a sorceress in purple holding a golden wand.
avernus: A dark pit ringed by dead black trees; a warrior in red with a bronze helmet stands at its edge by a small trench of dark blood. No house.
sirens: Three sirens, women with brown bird wings, perched on sharp grey rocks.
scylla: A sheer, needle-sharp grey sea crag of bare rock with a dark cave at its foot. No building.
thrinacia: A herd of golden and white cattle, a white pillar topped with a golden sun disc, and a herdswoman in gold.
ogygia: A grey rock outcrop with pointed crags, green bushes and a natural cave mouth in bare grey rock (a cave, not a building); a nymph in a sea-green dress, and a wooden raft with a sail on the shore.
scheria: A palace with a golden roof and a blue door flanked by golden hound statues, an orchard in rows, and a princess in white holding a red ball.
ithaca: A farmhouse with a terracotta roof, a woman in blue weaving at a purple loom, a dog and a wooden fence.
